summary: Focused implementing-agent source and artifact review of v2.0.0-GA revision16. All 30 packaged files match source. No automatic Sheet lookups remain in preview/monthly/executive/publication paths; missing Measure stays unassigned. Read-only preview uses displayed text and never writes. Normal goal/Path-to-Green requirements and factual AI guards remain. Not Started enum, UI, save and schema/publication checks agree; Review Status saves preserve drafts. Loading lifecycle and side-positioned summary tooltip are covered by focused browser checks. This is not an independent review.
caveats: Actual hosted browser and production SDK/model outputs remain unverified; no guarantee of model acceptance is inferred from fixture checks.
Absent Measure is intentionally unassigned and flagged separately; normal missing goals or required Path to Green can still block generation/publication.
Existing non-atomic GUS writes, sharing, metadata limitations, source truncation and human review requirements remain.
Validation is limited to 12 focused Node tests, syntax checks and one combined isolated browser flow; no full suite.
